text.title: ADA Title II Compliance 2026 Failure Modes
text.summary: 5 antipatterns observed when applying ada-title-ii-compliance-2026; each pairs symptom + root cause + concrete fix.

antipattern.symptom: Report scores against WCAG 2.2 AA assuming higher target satisfies the rule.
antipattern.root-cause: Audit team applied current 'best practice' instead of the rule text. Agent auto-applies WCAG 2.2 success criteria as required under Title II. WCAG 2.2 SCs are not part of the DOJ final rule; marking them required overstates the legal obligation.
antipattern.fix: Audit MUST score against 2.1 AA explicitly; report MAY note additional 2.2 AA progress as bonus.

antipattern.symptom: Embedded video provider + payment widget excluded from scope; user complaint reaches OCR/DOJ.
antipattern.root-cause: Assumption that vendor-provided components are out of scope. Agent claims embedded third-party content is not in scope for the covered entity. Third-party content embedded in a covered entity's site can still trigger the covered entity's compliance obligation.
antipattern.fix: Vendor contracts MUST require WCAG 2.1 AA; embedded surfaces in audit scope.

antipattern.symptom: Conformance memo signed by CIO with no Stage 4 (screen reader) evidence.
antipattern.root-cause: Short timeline pressure → attestation without audit.
antipattern.fix: Reject report without Stage 1-5 audit evidence; budget for audit before deadline.

antipattern.symptom: Agent marks pre-existing PDFs as exempt from all accessibility requirements.
antipattern.root-cause: Pre-existing PDFs must still be remediated on request even if created before the compliance deadline; the exemption is not blanket.
antipattern.fix: Apply the three-part archived-content test (unaltered, marked archived, not in current use) per document; keep an on-request remediation path for everything else.

antipattern.symptom: Agent drafts an undue-burden claim without legal and financial analysis.
antipattern.root-cause: Undue-burden defenses under Title II require entity-level financial analysis; an agent lacks the standing and data to make this determination.
antipattern.fix: Route any undue-burden question to legal counsel with the entity's financial data; the agent records the question, never the determination.
